# Jaron Mobley

> Freelance videographer based in Palmer, Alaska. Makes mini-documentaries and
> brand films for small teams, and shoots and edits every project himself.

Jaron works primarily in outdoor and documentary film: profiles of the people
behind a business, product launches shot on location, and long-form highlight
work. He handles the whole chain — planning, shooting, and colour — so the
person a client plans the day with is the person holding the camera.

Available nights and weekends. Contact: jaronmobley@gmail.com

## What he does

- Mini-documentaries and profiles
- Brand films and product launches
- Outdoor and adventure cinematography
- Stills photography alongside motion work
- Colour grading

## Selected work

- [Nunatak Apex](https://jaronmobley.com/#work): Summer alpine product launch for Alaska Gear Company, shot across the Denali Highway.
- [Pilot Profile: Matt Williams](https://jaronmobley.com/#work): Documentary profile of a bush pilot.
- [Adventure Packs Release](https://jaronmobley.com/#work): Product release film for Alaska Gear Company.
- [Winter Campaign](https://jaronmobley.com/#work): Cold-weather brand campaign.
- [Alaskan Bushwheels Summer Highlight Reel 2024](https://jaronmobley.com/#work): Season highlight reel for Alaskan Bushwheels.

## Writing

Field Notes are write-ups from between shoots — what the day was like, who was
there, and what came back on the card.

- [Field Notes index](https://jaronmobley.com/blog)
- [April Bowl to Government Peak Traverse](https://jaronmobley.com/blog/april-bowl-government-peak): A late-season traverse in Hatcher Pass, shot on a Fujifilm X-T3.
- [The Toughest 5K in the World: Mount Marathon 2026](https://jaronmobley.com/blog/mount-marathon-2026): Photographing the Mount Marathon race in Seward.
- [Fat Bikes to the Knik Glacier](https://jaronmobley.com/blog/knik-glacier-xt3): A winter fat-bike trip out to the Knik Glacier.
